extension.name: Configuration Manager
extension.description: CiviCRM configuration management with YAML export/import, UI, API4 automation, and system-status checks.
extension.comments: Alpha 58 development build on the full alpha57 codebase: adds universal managed/watch/ignored scope, portable selected-item identities, explicit watch scans, safer selective deletion rules, friendlier synchronization UX, and cached no-scan system health.
